title: Sr Integration Engineer- Hyderabad (Hybrid)
description:
**Description**
 Sr Integration Engineer\- Hyderabad (Hybrid)
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
 Job Summary
   

  

 The Sr Integration Engineer will design, build, and support enterprise‑grade integration solutions that enable seamless data exchange, process orchestration, and intelligent automation across cloud, on‑prem, and SaaS platforms. This role combines traditional integration engineering withapplied AI capabilities, using automation, analytics, and intelligent services to improve reliability, observability, and efficiency of integration workflows. The Sr Integration Engineer is expected to take end‑to‑end ownership of integration deliverables, ensuring solutions meet business requirements, performance expectations, operational standards, and evolving AI‑enabled enterprise architecture needs.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implemententerprise integrations and APIsusing standard integration patterns (e.g., API‑led, asynchronous, event‑driven) to address specific business needs.
* Ensure best practices in developing and maintainingREST/SOAP services, data mappings, and orchestration logic.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teamsfor data transformation, validation, and automation.
* Implementerror handling, logging, monitoring, and reprocessingfor production‑ready integrations.
* ApplyAI‑assisted capabilitiessuch as intelligent error classification, anomaly detection, and proactive monitoring insights.
* Work withOracle Databaseand other enterprise systems to support integration workflows.
* Collaborate with architects, business teams, and support teams across the integration lifecycle.


 Qualification Requirements
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience buildingmiddleware or enterprise integration solutions.
* Experience withAPI design, data formats (JSON/XML), and integration protocols.
* Experience with distributed version control systems such as Git and CI/CD pipelines to manage code and deployments.
* Proficient with programming languages such as SQL, PL/SQL, and Python.
* Ability to own tasks and produce results for the business.
* Ability to own integrations end‑to‑end and communicate clearly with stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience withenterprise integration platforms(Oracle SOA Suite, OIC, or equivalent).
* Experience withAI or analyticsto enhance monitoring, automation, or data quality.
* Knowledge ofAPI management platforms.
* Knowledge of AI functions in Databricks.
* Knowledge of clinical trial data.


**Years of experience required:** 
 Three (3\)
   

  

**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
